context.title: Competency Framework: Description
context.description: The title, description, keywords, identifiers and contributors of the competency framework, with its version, life-cycle status, educational context and rights (Healthcare LOM). The title and an identifier with the catalog URI are required.

context.title: Competency Framework: Dates and Versions
context.description: When this version of the framework became effective and when it retired, and the URIs of the frameworks it replaces and of the one that replaces it. A retired framework should name its replacement.

context.title: Competency Framework: Supporting Information
context.description: Links to, or formatted text with, the rationale and intended use of the framework, its human readable version or the changes of this version.

context.title: Competency Framework: Included Competencies
context.description: The catalog and entry of every competency object or framework included in the framework, including those named in relations. Use the catalog URI for MedBiquitous competency objects.

context.title: Competency Framework: Relations
context.description: Broader, narrower and related relations between included competencies (SKOS). Cycles and hierarchical conflicts are forbidden.

context.title: Competency Object: Description
context.description: The statement (title), description, identifiers and contributors of the competency object, with its life-cycle status and rights (Healthcare LOM). The title and an identifier with the catalog URI are required.

context.title: Competency Object: Status and Versions
context.description: Whether the competency object is Active or Retired, and the URIs of the objects it replaces and of the one that replaces it.

context.title: Competency Object: Categories
context.description: Categories of the competency, like Atom categories: a required term, a scheme URI and a display label.

context.title: Competency Object: References and Supporting Information
context.description: References to the literature related to the competency, and a link to or formatted text with a longer description.

context.title: Performance Framework: Description
context.description: The title, description, keywords, identifiers and contributors of the performance framework, with its version, life-cycle status, educational context and rights (Healthcare LOM).

context.title: Performance Framework: Dates and Versions
context.description: When this version of the framework became effective and when it retired, and the URIs of the frameworks it replaces and of the one that replaces it.

context.title: Performance Framework: Supporting Information
context.description: References (RDF) to, or formatted text with, the rationale and intended use of the framework.

context.title: Performance Framework: Performance Scales
context.description: The numeric scales of the performance levels: an id and the scores of the least and most competent ends.

context.title: Performance Framework: Components
context.description: The components of the framework: titles, abbreviations, authors, reviewers, nested components, thresholds and additional information.

context.title: Performance Framework: Performance Levels
context.description: The performance level set of each component: its scale and the levels with display order, score, labels and indicators.
